description: Synthetic text fixture; casual first-person gaming commentary. No speech audio and no ASR.
lines: I usually breeze through ranked; it feels free when we warm up.
I'm not queueing ranked tonight because those lobbies are rough.
My aim is awful before coffee.
We got wiped rotating through mid because I took the long route.
I always duo with Kai on weekends.
I never solo queue after midnight.
I think the new map is way better for snipers.
I'm saving my ult until the next fight.
I said the audio mix makes footsteps impossible to hear.
The patch fixed the recoil on my rifle.
I hate playing support when nobody watches flank.
I actually enjoy the chaos in quickplay.
We won that round because I waited before pushing.
I'm not blaming the healer; I overextended.
I could play another game, but my hands need a break.
I turned off motion blur for smoother frames.
The boss is easier if I stay close.
I miss the old ranked map rotation.
I accidentally bought the wrong skin.
I don't think the new shotgun is balanced.
I'm dropping at the harbor this match.
I use the left trigger to aim.
I changed my sensitivity from 4 to 5.
Our team should regroup instead of trickling in.
I heard someone upstairs, but I don't know where.
I was one hit from winning that duel.
I prefer controller for this game.
I haven't unlocked the gold camo yet.
I think the server lagged right as I fired.
I'm going to heal before we re-enter.
I wish the menu loaded faster.
We should save credits for next season.
I'm trying a different loadout today.
I keep forgetting to reload after fights.
The ranked grind is easy when I'm playing with friends.
I usually play solo, but tonight the squad is here.
I would never use that scope at this range.
I can hear the game, but my mic is muted.
I had a clean headshot from across the map.
I'm finished after this match; no more games.
